about: Golden cases for the milestone handoff contract (server-spec/milestone-handoff.md). records: a handoff record validates against server-spec/schemas/milestone-handoff/handoff.schema.json (check MH1). head: events replay in comment order; handoff moves a milestone head only when accepted, verdict is recorded, authorize checks the verdict against the head at that moment (check MH2). routing: a handoff's recipient role resolves to one active binding or a rule refuses (MH3). bindings and authority: who may create, replace and revoke a binding, and that only a claim lets a recipient work (MH4). delivery: delivery-state events in order (MH5). retry: the bounded retry offsets and the stable deduplication key (MH6). negotiation: the mode an agent uses from a server's capabilities and tools (MH7).

head.name: head-first
head.what: the first handoff on a milestone becomes its head

head.name: head-supersede
head.what: a successor naming the head and a new revision replaces it

head.name: head-stale-base
head.what: a second handoff that does not name the head is refused

head.name: head-same-revision
head.what: a successor must change the revision

head.name: head-unknown-base
head.what: a first handoff cannot name a successor target

head.name: verdict-current
head.what: a verdict naming the head's handoff and revision is effective

head.name: verdict-old-revision
head.what: accepting an old revision cannot authorize a newer one

head.name: verdict-race-supersede
head.what: a supersession that lands before the check wins over an old verdict; one that lands after leaves the earlier authorization standing for its own revision only

head.name: verdict-no-milestone
head.what: a verdict that names no milestone is refused

head.name: verdict-no-revision
head.what: a verdict that names no revision is refused

head.name: verdict-no-handoff
head.what: a verdict on a milestone with no handoff is refused

head.name: verdict-other-milestone
head.what: a verdict is effective for its own milestone only

routing.name: route-ok
routing.what: a reviewer role resolves to the one active binding

routing.name: route-named
routing.what: a named principal resolves to its own binding

routing.name: route-expired
routing.what: an expired binding is not a route

routing.name: route-revoked
routing.what: a revoked binding is not a route

routing.name: route-ambiguous
routing.what: two principals bound to the role and none named

routing.name: route-unauthorized-role
routing.what: a binding for a role the principal is no longer authorized for is not a route

routing.name: route-named-unbound
routing.what: the named principal has no binding

routing.name: route-self-review
routing.what: a review is never routed to the sender's own session

routing.name: route-worker
routing.what: a worker role needs no extra authorization

bindings.name: bind-own
bindings.what: a principal binds its own session for an authorized role

bindings.name: bind-replace
bindings.what: a principal replaces its own binding

bindings.name: bind-worker
bindings.what: the worker role needs no grant

bindings.name: bind-owner-by-agent
bindings.what: an agent never binds the owner role

bindings.name: bind-unauthorized
bindings.what: a role the owner has not granted the principal

bindings.name: bind-ttl-long
bindings.what: a binding lasts at most 24 hours

bindings.name: revoke-owner
bindings.what: the owner may revoke any binding

authority.name: work-claim-review
authority.what: a review claim for the handoff's item lets a reviewer work

authority.name: work-no-claim
authority.what: a delivered, acknowledged handoff without a claim grants nothing

authority.name: work-comment-only
authority.what: a comment naming the reviewer is not authority

authority.name: work-role-name
authority.what: a role name alone is not authority

authority.name: work-wrong-purpose
authority.what: a work claim does not meet a review scope

authority.name: work-self-review
authority.what: a review by the session that did the work is forbidden

delivery.name: lost-ack
delivery.what: an acknowledgement the sender never saw is safely repeated

delivery.name: ack-before-deliver
delivery.what: a recipient that polled can acknowledge a handoff whose delivery record was lost

delivery.name: failed-exhausted
delivery.what: delivery that never succeeds fails after its attempts and escalates

delivery.name: fail-early
delivery.what: failure before the attempts are used is refused

delivery.name: ack-wrong-revision
delivery.what: an acknowledgement names the revision it received

delivery.name: ack-wrong-delivery
delivery.what: an acknowledgement names the delivery id

delivery.name: ack-after-supersede
delivery.what: a delayed acknowledgement after supersession is recorded as stale

delivery.name: ack-after-cancel
delivery.what: an acknowledgement of a cancelled handoff is refused

delivery.name: cancel-pending
delivery.what: a pending handoff may be cancelled

delivery.name: cancel-acknowledged
delivery.what: an acknowledged handoff cannot be cancelled

delivery.name: deliver-after-cancel
delivery.what: an in-flight delivery after a cancel changes nothing

retry.name: retry-capped
retry.what: the delay doubles from one minute and stops at thirty

retry.name: dedupe-stable
retry.what: the deduplication key is fixed by handoff, revision and recipient

retry.name: dedupe-new-revision
retry.what: a new revision is a new key

retry.name: dedupe-other-recipient
retry.what: another recipient is a new key

negotiation.name: negotiate-none
negotiation.what: a legacy server offers nothing: the sender posts the packet as a comment and says delivery is manual

negotiation.name: negotiate-tools-only
negotiation.what: tools without the capability name are not trusted

negotiation.name: negotiate-poll
negotiation.what: the capability and the core tools without push: the recipient polls

negotiation.name: negotiate-push
negotiation.what: push claimed and backed by the binding tools: the server delivers to bound sessions

negotiation.name: negotiate-push-no-bind
negotiation.what: push claimed but the binding tools are missing: poll

negotiation.name: negotiate-no-ack
negotiation.what: the capability claimed with the acknowledgement tool missing: manual

negotiation.name: negotiate-future-version
negotiation.what: only a later version named: manual
